title: Chapter 43 — The Renovation Contractor
intro: The highest-frequency trade account — the chaos they live in and how to become their infrastructure.

sections.title: Speed and Reliability Win
sections.content:
Renovation contractors work in chaos — changing scopes, shifting timelines, homeowner decisions that change daily. They need a supplier who responds fast, quotes accurately, and delivers on time.

Become the person they call first because you always answer, always follow through, and never create surprises.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating contractor relationships, ask:

Is the salesperson responsive — same-day quotes, same-day answers?
Do contractors trust them enough to be the default call?
Is the relationship growing — or stagnant?
